text.aria-label: Title text 'D5, labelled event 146: +2.90 MW for 39.6 days from 2025-12-05. 580 status: label has wrong dates or sign; the power readings show a different event. NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth. Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.'
text.tspan: D5, labelled event 146: +2.90 MW for 39.6 days from 2025-12-05. 580 status: label has wrong dates or sign; the power readings show a different event.
NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth.
Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.
